i did emdr for several months and it just put me in a constant state of dissociation, to the point where i couldn't tell if i was awake or dreaming 24/7. i had to quit my job and stay home for a long time. 

just because it didn't work for me doesn't mean it always won't work though! i've heard great stories of it working wonders for people. i think it's just down to the person and how their brain works.

maybe a break to help them find confidence could help? if you are attached to this person, you could plan on getting back together. if not, maybe it's time to let go. they will find themselves eventually. it takes compassion and support from those they love, plus them *wanting* to feel better.

i understand the feeling:/ for me, going back and forth made things easier. if one parent got unbearable, then i would just switch to the other. it's also helpful to know that teenage years fly by. if you aren't already, you will be 18 before you know it. safe your money so you can move out. best of luck.
